configurations.//: ATTACH to the running M8 compose stack — no command, so nothing is started and no port is bound. This is the entry to use for previewing the real app: `pnpm stack:up` brings up all ten services plus LocalStack, Redpanda, clamd and tesseract, and the web container publishes 3000. The two from-source entries below cannot substitute for it — web alone 500s without a BFF, and real auth/assets/documents data needs the whole stack. Port 3000 specifically: docs/05 and the M8 PR3 decision address the stack at http://localhost:3000 (BFF Secure cookies rely on the browser's localhost exemption).
configurations.name: stack

configurations.//: From-source dev servers, for frontend work with no stack running. Both conflict with the stack's published ports by design — they are the same app, so use `stack` above instead of relocating these.
configurations.name: web
